Didn’t expect this from budget earbuds… but the GoBoult Z40 PRO V2 actually delivers.

You’re getting:
 • 32dB Active Noise Cancellation 🎧
• Massive 100 Hours Playtime 🔋
• Deep bass with 13mm drivers 🔊

• Custom EQ via app ⚙️

And the design? Premium matte-metal vibe — no fingerprints, no cheap feel.
Honestly, for ₹1499… this feels like a steal.

🎧 GoBoult Z40 PRO V2
